about.title: Global Transit and Transport Services
about.intro: Global Transit coordinates freight between global markets and East Africa, with an operational base in Djibouti. We connect ports, corridors and clients for reliable, traceable and compliant flows.
about.cardText: Logistics, transit and customs expertise based in Djibouti.
about.cardCheck: Trusted partner for your regional and international freight operations.
about.missionP1: Facilitate market access for Ethiopian and regional importers and exporters by securing the end-to-end logistics chain.
about.missionP2: We align customs procedures, transit and information to reduce delays and operational risks.
about.strengthsKicker: See how we work to help your business
about.strengthsIntro: An experienced team, secure operations and full mastery of the Djibouti - Ethiopia corridor. Compliance, fast execution and dedicated support.
about.svcLogisticsText: Handling, storage and door-to-door coordination for your import/export flows.
about.svcTransitText: Goods transit on the Djibouti–Ethiopia corridor with operational tracking.
about.svcClearanceText: Import/export formalities and customs clearance at the port of Djibouti.
about.svcCustomsText: Support for customs systems and regulatory compliance.
about.svcDocsText: Tracking of invoices, certificates and administrative documents.
about.teamSubtitle: An experienced team in transit, logistics and customs clearance, reachable directly via WhatsApp, email or professional profile.
about.teamAdminHint: Our team will be presented here very soon.
about.teamNoContact: Contact details not set in the admin panel.
about.yousoufBio: As Operation Manager at Global Transit, Yousouf Haroun leads day-to-day operations with strong field coordination and client focus to ensure reliable, compliant and high-performance logistics flows.
about.moustafeBio: As Finance Manager at Global Transit, Moustafe Warsama Omar oversees financial operations, budget control, and data reliability to support logistics performance.
about.aboubakerBio: As Assistant Manager at Global Transit, Aboubaker Helaf supports team coordination, operations follow-up, and service quality to ensure smooth field execution.
about.ibrahimTitle: General Manager, Global Transit and Transport Services
about.ibrahimMessageP1: At Global Transit and Transport Services, our mission is to deliver reliable, efficient, and professional logistics solutions that connect businesses across Djibouti, East Africa, and international markets. We understand that transport, customs coordination, and freight management are essential to the success of our clients' operations, and we are committed to providing services that meet the highest standards of quality, speed, and accountability.
about.ibrahimMessageP2: Our company is built on strong values, trust, teamwork, communication, and operational excellence. With solid field experience in transit, clearance, logistics, and customs procedures, we work every day to ensure smooth cargo movement and dependable support for importers, exporters, and business partners.
about.ibrahimMessageP3: We believe that success in logistics depends on careful planning, fast execution, and strong customer relationships. That is why we continue to improve our processes, strengthen our expertise, and invest in dependable service delivery.
about.ibrahimMessageP4: On behalf of Global Transit and Transport Services, I would like to thank our clients, partners, and team members for their trust and continued collaboration. Together, we move business forward with confidence, professionalism, and commitment.
about.experienceText: {{years}} years of operational experience in transit, logistics and customs clearance on the Djibouti – Ethiopia corridor.
about.asideMissionText: Provide reliable and transparent logistics solutions for your flows between Europe, Asia and East Africa, via Djibouti.

pres.title: Global Transit and Transport Services at a glance
pres.p1: Based in Djibouti, Global Transit and Transport Services is a transit, transport and logistics company specialising in the Djibouti – Ethiopia corridor and East Africa.
pres.p2: Since {{year}}, we have supported importers, exporters and partners with customs clearance, document management, warehousing and road or multimodal routing from the Port of Djibouti to the final destination.
pres.p3: Our commitment: reliable, transparent and compliant operations, with continuous follow-up of every file.
pres.corridorValue: Port of Djibouti → Dire Dawa → Addis Ababa

highlights.processIntro: From your first request to final delivery, we handle every step of your import-export operation.
highlights.step1Text: We review your cargo, its destination and your deadlines to propose the best solution.
highlights.step2Text: Preparation and checking of transport documents and administrative formalities.
highlights.step3Text: Compliant customs declarations and procedures, for imports and transit.
highlights.step4Text: Road or multimodal routing from the Port of Djibouti to Ethiopia and the region.
highlights.step5Text: Continuous monitoring and regular updates until final delivery.
